thread:
Maya (Content): Quick kickoff — shipping StarterKits MiniLab (OSS). Deliverables: short launch post, 2-paragraph bench note, 45m webinar + 30m hands-on lab.
Jon (DevRel): Lab needs to be 20-25m runnable: repo tour, local run, perf check. I'll make a tiny checklist.
Rita (PMM): Bench story should be humble and reproducible. Let's report p90 @256 & cost delta vs hosted for single-request bursts.
Diego (SRE): I'll run a small bench (GPU-ish and CPU sim) and drop CSV + 1 chart. Sample command to include:
```
RW_KEY=... ./bench/run.sh --model mini --seq 256 --concurrency 2
```
Sam (Growth): Landing page must tag utm=starterkits_launch and feed HubSpot. Promo plan: announce, 2 reminders, day-of paid push, and a repo follow-up drip.
Maya (Content): Draft headline idea: "StarterKits MiniLab — quickstart for private inference." I'll draft blog + a concise tweet thread by Thu.
Jon (DevRel): Repo layout: /quickstart, /bench, /lab-notebook, /troubleshoot. Include a minimal docker and k8s example for the lab.
Diego (SRE): I'll prepare a tiny docker image and single-file k8s manifest. Also a telemetry snippet printing latency and tps.
Rita (PMM): Inbound routing: registrants -> list starterkits_regs; attended -> tag starterkits:attended; >2 opens -> mark warm and notify AEs.
Maya (Content): Owners: Maya=blog+tweets; Jon=repo+lab; Diego=bench+artifacts; Rita=landing+routing; Sam=promo. Dry run 7 days before.
webinar-bot: Reminder: schedule webinar with template "webinar-standard" >= 21 days out.
Maya (Content): Any blockers?
Jon (DevRel): Starting repo skeleton now. No blockers.
